summary: The CAM Inspect task panel gains a "Show tool: <name>" checkbox that toggles the tool shape, makes the G-code editor read-only, moves tool placement and path highlighting to follow the text cursor instead of the selection, and no longer draws the leading rapid from the origin.

pages.reason: Path/Main/Gui/Inspect.py: new 'Show tool' QCheckBox in a bottom frame toggles tool Visibility (restored on close); editor set read-only via TextInteractionFlags; highlightpath/toolPlacement now connected to cursorPositionChanged rather than selectionChanged; selectionobj StartIndex=1 hides the initial rapid move
